phases.objective: Route every platform_resource_authority_bindings read and write through the dedicated Governance DB pool while preserving fail-closed behavior and runtime evidence separation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Governance Authority Store executor and governed repository capability paths
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Authority writes, scoped reads, recipe resolution, and repository readback use the Governance DB source without a Runtime DB fallback.
steps: Evaluate the Production provider capability for an independent Governance database and exact grants.
Configure an isolated Governance DB pool and a distinct Runtime DB pool.
Reject missing or Runtime-equal Governance database names before pool creation.
Exercise authority write and same-source readback contracts.
Resolve a platform resource capability through the Governance authority source.
Verify governed repository readback fails closed when the authority source is unavailable or mismatched.
assertions: Production provider capability recognizes the independent two-database contract without performing provider mutation.
Promotion run resolution selects the newest eligible exact-head workflow run and excludes completed failure/skip runs.
Authority reads and writes select the explicit Governance DB pool.
A missing or Runtime-equal Governance database name fails closed before connection creation.
A missing or ambiguous authority binding does not fall back to the Runtime DB.
Scoped authority resolution remains tenant and workspace bounded.
Repository governance readback preserves fail-closed binding validation.

phases.objective: Add deployed Hostinger Governance DB provisioning, grant readback, and operational monitoring after explicit infrastructure approval.
Add reconciliation and recovery evidence for Governance DB availability and authority-source drift.
Validate one non-production Hostinger tenant with separate Runtime and Governance database identities.
Verify exact production readback only after approved Hostinger provisioning and redeployment.
